Extract all images from a document into metadata

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><title>Gallery</title></head><body><img src=\"https://example.com/photo1.jpg\" alt=\"Photo 1\"><img src=\"https://example.com/photo2.png\" alt=\"Photo 2\"><img src=\"/local/image.webp\" alt=\"Local image\"></body></html>", "{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
